name: Low-dose CT Denoising Benchmark
description: A benchmark evaluating deep learning algorithms for denoising low-dose CT images.
evaluation_method: PSNR and SSIM (peak signal-to-noise ratio, structural similarity)
reputation: Moderately used in the medical imaging research community for benchmarking CT denoising methods, but not a single universal standard.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark. Results depend strongly on dose protocol and whether noise is simulated or real; datasets can be small and methods may overfit to specific scanners/protocols.
